tools.name: generate-flashcards
tools.title: Generate Flashcards
tools.description: Create and save flashcards. Before calling this tool, convert the user's topic or notes into Markdown cards using 'Question\n==\nAnswer', separate cards with a line containing '---', and put tags on the final line. Pass the generated Markdown in the markdown field; never pass the topic sentence directly.
